project_north_star: AKAH is not bounded by F10 or by the historical 11.23x clairvoyant diagnostic. The project now integrates cumulative causal evidence across the governance history: keep H0 and the risk governor as protection; reduce avoidable execution friction; allocate more capital selectively to strong opportunities; renew ownership of persistent winners through pyramiding/reacquisition rather than blind holding; use replacement only when a candidate is strong, an incumbent is weak, and the frozen replacement model is positive; and test narrowly-gated escape routes for large trends missed by the F10 gate. 2024 remains permanently sealed.
